newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-KARLSRUHE'S TARNAT TO JOIN BAYERN MUNICH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-KARLSRUHE'S TARNAT TO JOIN BAYERN MUNICH.

text.p: Karlsruhe's German international wing-back Michael Tarnat will join Bayern Munich next season to replace Italy-bound international Christian Ziege.
The move was announced before the two teams clashed in the German first division on Sunday.
Germany's Euro 96 player Ziege is to join AC Milan at the end of the season and Tarnat will take his place on the left flank.

Bayern are presently looking for players, especially after striker Juergen Klinsmann announced earlier in the week that he was leaving at the end of the season. VfB Stuttgart's Brazilian forward Giovane Elber is expected to replace him.
